messages.en:
{07 14 00}{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 0e 00}Hmmmm... {01 01 00}{07 14 00}That's cool, but
I'd fill my pool with
crème brûlée, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{09 09 00}
Then I could lounge all
day and crack a hole in
the burnt, sugary crust.
And if I'm feelin' snacky,
I could dip my hand in and
grab a handful of crème.
{07 0a 00}It'd be like ice fishing,
except without the ice or
the fishing!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 0e 00}Hmmmm... {01 01 00}{07 14 00}Lahe, aga mina
täidaksin oma basseini
crème brûléega, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{09 09 00}
Siis saaksin terve päeva
logeleda ja lüüa augu
kõrbenud suhkrukoorikusse.
Ja kui tuleks näpsuisu,
võiksin käe sisse pista ja
haarata peotäie kreemi.
{07 0a 00}See oleks nagu jääpüük,
ainult ilma jää ja
püügita!

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 06 00}But I don't have a pool
at my house!

{07 0b 00}Do you think {ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook {ff 00 00 00}would
dig one for me,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{09 09 00}

{07 00 00}{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 00 00}Dig you a pool?! HAH! He's
way too flabby to dig a pit
that deep!
{09 02 00}{07 00 00}{09 01 00}{07 16 00}Besides, he'd probably chow
all your pool fillings
before it was even done!
But I guess that's what
makes {ff 00 00 06}Nook {ff 00 00 00}kinda charming,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 00 00}Kaevaks basseini?! HAH!
Ta on liiga lõtv, et nii
sügavat auku kaevata!
{09 02 00}{07 00 00}{09 01 00}{07 16 00}Pealegi õgiks ta ilmselt
kogu su basseinitäite ära
enne, kui valmis saaks!
Aga vist just see teebki
{ff 00 00 06}Nooki {ff 00 00 00}pisut võluvaks,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 14 00}Yeah...{01 00 00 14 00} {07 0d 00}You know what I
think makes him so
charming? His fluffy tail.
Not that I stare at it all
the time, {07 03 00}huh huh huh.{03 01 00 01}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 14 00}Jah...{01 00 00 14 00} {07 0d 00}Tead, mis teeb
ta minu arust nii
võluvaks? Ta kohev saba.
Mitte et ma seda kogu aeg
vahiksin, {07 03 00}hah hah hah.{03 01 00 01}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 02 00}You don't sweat?!{01 00 00 0a 00} Bro, are
you some kind of alien,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 06 00}'Cause if you are, I'm gonna
be forced to crush you
like a soda can!{09 02 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 02 00}Sa ei higista?!{01 00 00 0a 00} Vend, kas
sa oled mingi tulnukas,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 06 00}Sest kui oled, siis pean ma
sind litsuma nagu
limonaadipurki!{09 02 00}
